parameters.apprise_url_plus: whatsapp://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.token_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.from_phone_id_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.targets_secret }} }
parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own WhatsApp destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-whatsapp_msg` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). On the `apprise` channels the gateway composes an Apprise `whatsapp://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available. The free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters. The `gateway` and `gateway-plus` channels instead skip Apprise and transform the envelope into a native WhatsApp Cloud API `{messaging_product, to, type, text}` payload delivered straight to graph.facebook.com: `gateway` is free, direct to the WhatsApp Cloud API, and `gateway-plus` is $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment WhatsApp destinations.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment WhatsApp destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to the WhatsApp Cloud API (no Apprise)

from_phone_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's WhatsApp from phone id

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's WhatsApp targets

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's WhatsApp token
